title: Fraidrine
html_source: A phonetic spelling of Fred Ryan. Stephen mentally mocking Eglinton’s accent in retaliation for Eglinton’s insult about Stephen wanting to be paid for his work.

anchor.prefix:
Other chap. 

 — You are the only contributor to Dana who asks for pieces of silver. Then I don't know about the next number. Fred Ryan wants space for an article on economics.
anchor.suffix:
. Two pieces of silver he lent me. Tide you over. Economics. 

 — For a guinea, Stephen said, you can publish this interview.
